headline: GOLD ERASES ALL OF 2026'S GAINS IN ONE DAY — BLOWOUT JOBS REPORT REVIVES FED RATE HIKE BETS
snippet: Gold lost nearly 4% on Friday after May payrolls crushed estimates — 172,000 jobs added vs. 85,000 forecast — dropping below $4,370 to its lowest level of 2026. Markets now price a 51% chance the Fed raises rates by December, reversing earlier cut expectations and hammering precious metals.

headline: COPPER DROPS 1.5% AS CHILE POSTS WORST APRIL OUTPUT IN 23 YEARS — U.S. TARIFF RULING DUE JUNE 30
snippet: Chile's copper output plunged 13.8% year-on-year to 399,954 tonnes in April — the weakest April in 23 years. Copper fell to $6.42/lb Friday as rate-hike fears hit demand outlook; the U.S. Commerce Dept must deliver a phased-tariff recommendation on refined copper imports by June 30.

headline: VISIBLE GOLD IN FIRST TWO HOLES: METALS CREEK HITS OGDEN TARGET IN TIMMINS DISTRICT
snippet: Metals Creek Resources (TSXV: MEK) reported encouraging visible gold in the first two drill holes of its 2026 campaign at the Ogden Gold Project near Timmins, Ontario. The project is a 50/50 JV with Discovery Silver, with Metals Creek as operator.

headline: ORLA MINING RESTARTS CAMINO ROJO AFTER ILLEGAL UNION BLOCKADE ENDS — 2026 GUIDANCE INTACT
snippet: Orla Mining (NYSE: ORLA) resumed operations at its Camino Rojo gold mine in Zacatecas, Mexico on June 5 after a four-day illegal union blockade ended with Mexican federal labour authorities ordering it lifted. The company reiterates 2026 production guidance of 110,000–120,000 ounces gold.

headline: NEW FOUND GOLD DOUBLES QUEENSWAY: SIX RIGS, 90,000M, $44M FULLY FUNDED IN NEWFOUNDLAND
snippet: New Found Gold (TSXV: NFGC) expanded its 2026 Queensway program on June 2 to 90,000m with six drill rigs, adding 40,000m of targeted exploration drilling alongside a large resource conversion program. The $44M fully funded effort covers AFZ extensions and multiple regional gold targets across Newfoundland.

headline: TROILUS COPPER-GOLD CLEARS KEY HURDLE: FULL 70MW HYDRO-QUÉBEC POWER ALLOCATION SECURED
snippet: Troilus Mining received a full 70MW power allocation from Hydro-Québec on June 2 — a major construction de-risking milestone for Quebec's largest copper project at the permitting stage. The project carries a 22-year mine life with average annual production of 303,000 gold-equivalent ounces.

headline: YUKON METALS FIRES UP DRILLS ON 5,000M COPPER-GOLD HUNT AT AZ AND BIRCH PROPERTIES
snippet: Yukon Metals Corp. (CSE: YMC) broke ground on its 2026 5,000m drill program at the AZ and Birch copper-gold properties on June 1, targeting porphyry zones confirmed by 3D induced polarization geophysics. Prior drilling at AZ returned a 47m gold-mineralized interval.

headline: SURGE BATTERY METALS RAISES C$30M FOR NEVADA LITHIUM — SAF GROUP'S PAES-BRAGA LEADS ROUND
snippet: Surge Battery Metals (TSXV: NILI) launched a C$30M (US$21.6M) private placement for its Nevada North lithium project, with an option to upsize to C$36M. The round is led by SAF Group's Brian Paes-Braga, who joins the company's strategic advisory board alongside Hess Capital's Michael Hess.

headline: URANIUM HOLDS $86/LB — UP 20% YEAR-OVER-YEAR — AS MIDDLE EAST WAR REPRICES ATHABASCA SUPPLY
snippet: Uranium spot price held at $86.15/lb on June 4, still 20% above year-ago levels after briefly touching $101.55 earlier in 2026. Western utilities are accelerating Athabasca Basin contracting as the Middle East conflict disrupts supply chains and a full U.S. ban on Russian enriched uranium looms in 2028.

headline: GRID STORAGE SURGE: ENERGY STORAGE TO CLAIM 31% OF ALL LITHIUM DEMAND IN 2026 — UP FROM 23% LAST YEAR
snippet: Guotai Junan projects energy storage will consume 31% of global lithium output in 2026, up from 23% in 2025, as grid-scale battery deployments grow 55% year-on-year. Total lithium demand is forecast above 500,000 metric tons — a structural shift rebalancing the market away from EV-only dependency.

headline: THE $534 GOLD GAP: WHY JUNIOR M&A STILL HASN'T RE-RATED DESPITE RECORD GOLD PRICES
snippet: Alain Gilbert's June 2026 M&A snapshot finds acquirers paying just $93/oz in the ground — a $534/oz gap vs. spot — despite gold trading above $4,500. The gap narrowed this month because gold pulled back, not because bid prices rose: the structural junior re-rating hasn't started yet.

headline: RECORD MARGINS, ZERO ATTENTION: WHY GOLD MINING STOCKS ARE THE TRADE NOBODY IS WATCHING
snippet: With gold holding above $4,400 and senior producers generating record free cash flow, the contrarian case for gold equities is quietly building. The 'buy the boredom' setup — peak profitability combined with institutional disinterest — mirrors conditions that preceded previous major sector re-ratings.
